name: Državni zbor (National Assembly)
notes: 90 seats (88 general plus 2 minority), elected 22 March 2026. Group sizes are the certified results of that election as listed by RTV SLO (https://www.rtvslo.si/slovenija/parlamentarne-volitve-2026/kdo-je-osvojil-poslansko-mesto-in-kdo-vse-je-izvisel/777176), checked against the eight parliamentary groups on the Državni zbor portal on 2026-11-04 (names; Levica group of 5 and Golob in the Svoboda group read there). The portal is script-rendered so the group sizes were not recounted from it; a minister's substitute does not change a group's size. Party switches since the election were not checked.
